tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
AS PER TENDER TERMS AND CONDITIONS

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Shall declare the source of supply with supporting documents.
Shall provide the Undertaking form as per annexure 2 of the tender document - Self certifying that supplied urea is Industrial (Technical Grade) and free from neem content.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Undertaking form as per annexure 2

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Direct dealers/ authorized suppliers/ distributors of GNFC/GSFC/IPL can participate in the tender and importers who have imported at least 1000 MT of Technical Grade Urea per year in their own trade name are allowed to participate in the tenders.

If Bidders quote prices significantly lower than the market prices (GNFC/GSFC/IPL), there are high possibilities of supplying of Neem adulterated agriculture grade urea with TG Urea. Considering the legal problems that may arise because of the above (Refer FCO 1985) as a precautionary measure, before accepting the said prices, KMF will obtain the purchase documents from the said bidders and will subject for further scrutiny to check for any discrepancies

In case of unreasonable price differences between the tender price and market price, KMF will drop the said prices/tender as a precautionary measure and block the concerned bidders from participating in the Urea tenders of KMF for a period of 03 months
